chapter.verse: Tua lai-a om mi kimkhat in Jesu' kiangah, Pilate in Galilee mite biakpiak a bawlna uhah amau' sisan zong helsak, cih thu gen uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: "Hih thu teng a thuakkhak manun hih Galilee mite, Galilee mi a dang teng khempeuh sangin mawhzaw ci-in ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
Hilo, kong ci hi! Ahih hangin na kisik kei uhleh note zong na si ding uh hi.
Ahihkeileh Siloam tausang a puk lai-in a denlup mi sawmlegiatte, Jerusalem khuami dangte khempeuh sangin mikhial a suksiazaw ci-in ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
Hilo, kong ci hi! Ahih hangin na kisik kei uhleh note zong na si ding uh hi."
Tua ciangin Jesuh in hih thugenteh, hih bangin gen hi: "Mi khat in a lenggah huan ah theikung khat nei a, kung tungah gah a va zon hangin mu lo hi.
Tua ciangin huancingpa' kiangah, 'En in, kum thum sung hih theikung tungah gah zong dingin kong pai a, gah ka muh kei hi. Phuk lel in. Bang hangin leitang siasak lai ding hiam?' ci hi.
Huancingpa in, 'Topa aw, tu kum zong hici omsak lai hoh in. A phung kimkot tovungin leihoihza ka sung phot ding hi.
Mai kum ah gah hong neih leh ahi pah, hong neih keileh lah phuktheih hi,' ci-in kho uh hi."
Tu-in Sabbath ni-in Jesu in vengkhawm inn khat ah thu hilhcian hi.
En un, kum sawmlegiat sung thazawmsak dawi a vei numei khat om a, amah a nung kulin dingtang theilo hi.
Jesu in a muh ciangin a kiangah sam a, "Numei aw, na thazawmna pan hong kisuaktasak ta hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin numei' tungah a khut a ngak leh thakhat thu-in numeinu dingtang thei pah a, Pasian' min phat hi.

Ahih hangin Sabbath ni-in Jesu in cina a damsak manin vengkhawm ukpa a hehsuakin mite' kiangah, "Nasep nadingin ni guk om hi. Tua nite ah hong pai unla damsakna sang un. Sabbath ni-in hong pai kei un," ci hi.

Tua ciangin Topa in hih bangin dawng hi: "No a puatham kineihte! Note khat ciat in Sabbath ni-in na bawng uh ahi-a na la uh ahi zongin gan buk pan khau sutin tuipia dingin paikhiatpih hilo na hi uh hiam?
Tua ci lehang, kum sawmlegiat sung Satan' khihcip Abraham' tanu khat ahi hih numei Sabbath ni-in kikhihna pan khahkhiat-huai hilo ahi hiam?"
Hih thute a gen ciangin a langte khempeuh' ading maizumna hi a, ahi zongin ama' sep naliante khempeuh hangin mite a vekun lungdam uh hi.
Tua hangin Jesu in hih bangin gen hi: "Pasian' kumpigam bang tawh kibang ahi hiam? Bang tawh ka genkak ding hiam?
Tua pen ankamtang, mi khat in phamin a huan ah a vawh pen, tawh kibang hi. Khaici khangin singkung khat suak a, van-a leng vasate in a hiangte tungah bu tom uh hi."
Tua ciangin gen leuleu a, "Pasian' kumpigam bang tawh genkak ding ka hi hiam?
Nupi khat in annel lawhbeub thum sunga a sawh, annel a bupin a pawmkim dongin a koih, silngo tawh kibang hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin khuapi khuaneute nawkin Jesu paisuak a, Jerusalem lam zuan kawmin thu hilhcian hi.
Tua laitak mi khat in, "Topa aw, hotkhiatna a ngah mi tawmkhat bek ahi ding hiam?" ci-in dong hi. Jesu in mite' kiangah hih bangin ci hi:
"Kong kawcik tawnin lutding hanciam un. A hang pen, ke'n kong cihin ah, mi tampi lut sawm ding uh a, ahi zongin lut zolo ding uh hi.

Inntekpa tho-in kong a khak khit ciangin note a pua ah dingin kong na kiu ding uh a, 'Topa aw, kote hong lutsak in,' ci-in na thum uh hangin amah in, 'Note koi pan hong pai cih ka thei kei hi,' ci-in hong dawng ding hi.
Tua ciangin note in, 'Na mai-ah anne tuidawnin ka om uh a, komau' lampite ah thu na hilh hi,' na ci ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, 'Ke'n kong cihin ah note koi pan hong pai cih ka thei kei hi. No thusia bawl mite aw, na vekun ka kiangpan paikhia un,' hong ci ding hi.
Pasian' kumpigam sungah Abraham, Isaac, Jacob leh kamsangte a om uh mu-in note lah a pua-ah hong kihawlkhiat ciangin tua mun ah kahna leh hagawina om ding hi.
Tua ciangin nisuahlam leh nitumlam pan ahi zongin, leilulam leh leitawlam pan ahi zongin mite hong pai ding uh a, Pasian' kumpigam sungah ankuang uumkhawm ding uh hi.
Tua hi a, en un, a masa dingte kimkhat nunung uh a, a nunung dingte kimkhat masa uh hi."
Tua hunlenai lianin Pharisee mi kimkhat hong pai-in Jesu' kiangah, "Paikhia inla hih lai pan kihem in. A hang pen Herod in nang hong that nuam hi," ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in hih bangin ci hi: "Pai unla tua ngia' kiangah, 'En in, tuni leh zingciangin dawite hawlkhia-in cina ka damsak ding a, ni thum ni-in ka zosiang ding hi,' cih thu va gen un.
Himah taleh tuni leh zingciang ahi-a thaiciang ahi zongin ka paisuak loh phamawh hi. A hang pen kamsang khat Jerusalem pualam ah a sih ding piang theilo hi.
Aw Jerusalem, Jerusalem aw, kamsangte a that, ama' kianga kisawl mite a denglum khuapi! Akpi in a no teng a kha nuai-ah a huai bangin na tate ka huai nuam den a, ahi zongin nang na ut kei hi.
En in, na inn uh hong kinusiat hi. Note kong cihin ah: 'Topa' min tawh hong pai mipa thuphangah ahi hi!' na cih matengun kei nong mu kei ding uh hi."Sabbath Ni-in Cibawk Mi Khat Dam
